scope: Integration contract for the separately maintained MoonCatDAO name-index repository. It identifies preferred finalized naming artifacts without vendoring them or asserting live chain state.

repository.reviewBoundary: The local sibling checkout was reviewed read-only. This contract is revision-bound and must not be read as a claim about a newer repository revision, deployed workflow, or live chain state.

canonicalEventHistory.role: Canonical finalized CatNamed event history, including blank naming attempts; use for history, audit, and rebuilding derived artifacts.
canonicalEventHistory.currentNameDerivation: Finalized current-name artifacts are derived from this finalized event history.

currentNames.role: One detailed finalized current-name record per successfully named MoonCat.

byCatId.role: Detailed finalized current-name records indexed by bytes5 catId.

byRescueOrder.role: Detailed finalized current-name records indexed by decimal rescueOrder.

simple.role: Display-oriented finalized decimal rescueOrder-to-name map; detailed artifacts retain broader raw/decode information.

metadata.role: Finalized index and scan metadata that downstream generation must record alongside its input revision.

provisionalArtifacts.role: Lower-latency overlays that include provisional events and may be removed, replaced, or reconciled. They are not canonical static naming state and must not be embedded into a canonical population artifact.

fieldSemantics.eventId: Stable event identity composed of transaction hash and log index.
fieldSemantics.namer: Immediate Ethereum transaction sender; may be a wallet or contract and is not necessarily the human chooser or beneficial owner.
fieldSemantics.namedOrder: One-based ordering derived from canonical blockNumber, transactionIndex, and logIndex for successful names.
fieldSemantics.namedYear: UTC year derived from the canonical block timestamp when available.
fieldSemantics.status: Name decoding/status classification retained with the raw value.
fieldSemantics.text: Decoded display text when the detailed record can provide it; it does not replace nameRaw.
fieldSemantics.nameRaw: Original bytes32 name value retained before display decoding.

namingInvariant.successfulNonblankState: A finalized nonzero name is immutable per cat under the original MoonCatRescue storage semantics.
namingInvariant.populationGrowth: The set of cats with finalized nonblank names is append-only as previously unnamed cats are successfully named.
namingInvariant.blankEvents: An all-zero CatNamed event remains in canonical event history but does not create a current-name record, consume naming state, or populate a current-name field.
namingInvariant.violationHandling: A changed finalized nonblank name for an already-named cat is an invariant-violation or data-corruption signal requiring investigation, not a normal refresh.

fullPopulationIndexGuidance.eligibleInput: Finalized nonblank name-index data may be incorporated directly as source-attributed monotonic enrichment in a future generated 25440-cat population index.
generationRequirements: Record the exact name-index repository revision and finalized metadata/artifact used.
Regenerate deliberately when the finalized named population grows; do not silently present an older enrichment as current.
Allow offline generation from a pinned local name-index checkout or copied CC0 finalized artifact; no live network access is required.
Reject or investigate a changed finalized nonblank name instead of accepting it as an ordinary update.
Exclude provisional/live artifacts from canonical output.

historicalSnapshotBoundary.role: Deterministic historical/source-comparison snapshot generated from mooncat_traits.json.
historicalSnapshotBoundary.notPreferredFor: Maintained current finalized names, canonical finalized CatNamed history, current naming order/year, namer, or blank-event history when the reviewed name-index artifacts are available.

observedMetadata.boundary: These are metadata observations from the reviewed revision, not timeless MoonCat facts; later finalized scans may advance them.

freshnessBoundary: Use the reviewed finalized artifacts for maintained data within their revision boundary. Stop for a newer-than-reviewed revision or live state only when the request actually requires it; this KB does not implement sync, GitHub API, RPC, webhook, or network fetching.
